evaluationUnit: division-months: sum of district estimates compared with observed VIIRS S-NPP

metricDefinitions.MAE: mean absolute error, detections per evaluation month
metricDefinitions.WAPE: sum of absolute errors / sum of observed counts (fraction, 0.2 = 20%)
metricDefinitions.sparseMonths: test evaluation months with fewer than 5 observed detections
metricDefinitions.zeroMonths: test evaluation months with zero observed detections

uncertainty.basis: 10th and 90th percentile of observed / estimated on 66 validation evaluation months with an estimate of at least 5

continuity: From the first complete VIIRS S-NPP month, harmonizedCount is the observed VIIRS count. Earlier months are estimates from MODIS Terra + Aqua (Terra only before July 2002).
notes: Counts are satellite hotspot detections, not distinct fires. Estimates are aggregate monthly counts, not new detections at exact places. Months before July 2002 use Terra only, so estimates there are likely low. Small counts have large relative error.
